# World Battery Hub — Technology

> Battery technology reference — materials, manufacturing processes, BMS and thermal management, and recycling technology. Sub-site of the World Battery Hub family.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/): Entry point to the battery technology reference.
- [Battery Materials](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-materials/): Battery materials overview.
- [Anode Materials](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/anode-materials/): Anode material technologies.
- [Cathode Materials](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/cathode-materials/): Cathode material technologies.
- [Graphite Anode](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/graphite-anode/): Graphite anode technology.
- [LCO Cathode](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lco-cathode/): Lithium cobalt oxide cathode.
- [LMFP Cathode](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lmfp-cathode/): Lithium manganese iron phosphate cathode.
- [Electrolyte & Separator](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-electrolyte-separator/): Electrolyte and separator technologies.
- [Electrolyte Additives](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/electrolyte-additives/): Electrolyte additive chemistries.
- [Separator & Electrolyte](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/separator-electrolyte/): Separator and electrolyte functions.
- [Lead-Acid Manufacturing](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lead-acid-manufacturing/): Lead-acid manufacturing process.
- [Lead Oxide](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lead-oxide/): Lead oxide production.
- [Grid Alloy](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/grid-alloy/): Grid alloy metallurgy.
- [Plate & Grid Design](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/plate-grid-design/): Plate and grid design.
- [Formation Charging](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/formation-charging/): Formation charging process.
- [Electrode Process](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/electrode-process/): Electrode fabrication process.
- [VRLA](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/vrla/): Valve-regulated lead-acid technology.
- [Gel Battery Technology](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/gel-battery-technology/): Gel battery technology.
- [Electrolyte Specific Gravity](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/electrolyte-specific-gravity/): Specific gravity measurement.
- [Lead-Acid Aging](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lead-acid-aging/): Lead-acid aging mechanisms.
- [Lithium Manufacturing](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-manufacturing/): Lithium battery manufacturing.
- [Lithium Cell / Module / Pack](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-cell-module-pack/): Cell, module, and pack assembly.
- [Lithium Cathode & Anode](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-cathode-anode/): Lithium cathode/anode overview.
- [Lithium BMS Technology](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-bms-technology/): Battery management systems.
- [Cell Balancing](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/cell-balancing/): Cell balancing methods.
- [Lithium Thermal Management](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-thermal-management/): Thermal management systems.
- [Pack Design](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/pack-design/): Battery pack design.
- [Quality Control](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/quality-control/): Battery manufacturing QC.

- [Battery Recycling Technology](https://technology.worldbatteryhub.com/battery-recycling-technology/): Recycling technology.

## Main site

- [World Battery Hub](https://worldbatteryhub.com/): Main knowledge hub (guides, tools, glossary, methodology).

## Notes

- Technical content is educational reference material, not engineering or design guidance for production; validate against standards and datasheets.
